items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

ctx.x: Oh. I think everybody writes a twelve tone blues at some point. Leonard Feather did it. So it turns out Stan was looking for a contrapuntal kind of approach and that was what I © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
was doing. So we had a connection right away. I just had to figure out how to make it work.
